capabilities: remove empty folders via the file explorer context menu
move removed folders to the Obsidian .trash folder for recovery
run repeatedly to catch folders emptied by earlier runs
extras: README warns users to back up vault data before running; deleted folders go to .trash so contents can be recovered, and empty folders created during a run require re-running the command.
problem: Obsidian leaves empty folders behind when notes are moved or merged, and there is no built-in way to clean them up in bulk.
summary: File-explorer command that removes empty folders in the vault, moving them to the .trash folder instead of deleting them.
